name: cairn
description: Local-first shared memory for AI coding agents. This plugin wires Cairn's MCP tools (recall, learn, plan). For the full passive experience (briefings, pitfall warnings, auto-capture), install the runtime and wire hooks once: npm install -g cairn-memory && cairn init — then run /hooks in Codex and trust the Cairn entries.

interface.defaultPrompt: Recall relevant project memory with cairn_recall before starting work, and store new lessons with cairn_learn.
